messages:
maria: heads-up from support: saved views that include model filters are confusing customers when runtime routes to different model. need clearer semantics.
lucas: can you give a concrete example? what are we storing today?
sam: user saved view with model=redwood-3b, runtime later routed to rdw-3b-quant for cost, customer expected redwood-3b exactly
maria: proposal: when saving, surface a tiny routing choice: [ ] Allow runtime fallback  [ ] Pin model (no fallback). provide short copy about cost vs consistency
ana: api options: include optional pinned_model_id in POST /saved-views or add routing_intent enum. I prefer pinned_model_id to avoid ambiguity
kevin: pinned_model_id SGTM. runtime must reject rather than silently fallback when pin set. return 409 with suggestion if unavailable
lucas: telemetry: we can return estimate for tokens/latency from sample queries. add telemetry tags saved_view_id and pinned_model_id so billing can join
maria: UX: show badge "Pinned model" or "Routable" in saved views list. show estimated token burn under name if available
sam: rollout: feature flag per-org, canary 5% orgs, async estimate fetch so save isn't blocked
ana: export/search must include pinned_model_id and estimate fields for downstream teams
kevin: defaults: self-serve -> routable default, enterprise/dedicated -> pin default. product to confirm
devx-bot: feature flag created: feature/save-routing-intent, canary 5%
maria: i'll draft design PR with modal copy and API proto. lucas will update server contract to accept pinned_model_id and emit telemetry tags
lucas: will add GET /telemetry/estimate?saved_view_id= for the console to call
maria: thanks all, will post links in PR when ready :thumbsup:
